LESSON: SIGN READING 1.2.1 SIGN READING READINESS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Sign Reading 1.2.1 Sign Reading readiness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 1.2.1 Sign Reading readiness, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we read the middle pages of a book? 2. How do we hold our books when reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 1.2.1 Sign Reading readiness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: learning independently as learner arranges pictures from left to right.

● Creativity and imagination: Flexibility as learner plays a game on turning picture book pages from left to right where they tap in

advance all pages with a picture but carefully not to tear it.

Values:
● Love: generosity as learner learns to share picture books as they play games on turning pages.

● Integrity: discipline as learner turns picture book pages with care not to tear it.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social economic awareness where learner learns to take care of books while reading to avoid unnecessary cost in replacement of

books.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Sign reading readiness is a skill needed in all Learning Activities. This means that up-bottom and left-right book reading skills as

well as turning pages from right to left are skills used across the Learning areas in preparation for learning.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as hearing aids and amplifiers, Pictures, signed video clips, pre recorded

songs, books, online resources, relevant digital devices.
